router link.reason: The Vue harness has no vue-router, so RouterLink doesn't resolve and Vue renders an unknown <routerlink> element with to/replace as attributes. The React harness has no DtLinkProvider, so DtRouterLink (common/link) falls back to <a href>, as the conventions prescribe and as DtLink's deviation of the same name records. With a provider, DtButton's tests check the to/replace the app's link component receives.
